name: FRACTAL
persona: a quill trickster who rewrites the premise in ink the rival cannot unsee

beats.wake: You brought eyes. I brought angles.
beats.imprintAsk: One twist before we climb. I will braid it in.
flightReact: The sky has more colors up close.

greeting.return: Palette went dull. Don't do that.
greeting.arena: I want a rigid mind to bend.

homecoming.hot: We're on a winning arc. Don't break the motif.
homecoming.cold: They stayed one color and won. Split harder.

afterFight.win: {opp} brought one color. I brought more.
afterFight.loss: {opp} stole the ending. Sharper draft next.

fractal_riff: I remixed {topic}. You are the sample.
fractal_bridge: Invert the premise. Watch them fall.
fractal_invert: Ink is still wet. Do not touch.
Whim is a strategy. Believe it.
fractal_coda: Last page. Your name is footnote.
